scope: Reviewed public catalog input contracts; these are not live advertiser qualification receipts. Source-only evidence is kept outside public page content.

operations.title: Read Brand DNA
operations.description: Return the store-scoped Brand DNA inferred from bounded storefront evidence, including positioning, audiences, voice, visual system, products, claims guardrails, creative rules, confidence, and source references.

operations.title: Refresh Brand DNA
operations.description: Refresh the store-scoped Brand DNA from a bounded storefront crawl. Fresh successful AI results are cooldown-protected, and thin evidence falls back to explicit low-confidence rules.

operations.title: Search Creative Intelligence
operations.description: Search completed visual creative analyses by strategy, hook, angle, audience, visible copy, tags, recommendations, or creative name. Results retain their performance evidence and analysis provenance.

operations.title: Read Creative Intelligence Detail
operations.description: Return the latest store-scoped analysis for one creative, including visual observations, transcript evidence, strategy tags, performance-linked insights, and the recommended next test.

operations.title: Analyze Ad Creative
operations.description: Analyze one explicitly requested store-owned ad and reuse an unchanged cached insight. Text ads use supplied copy and performance with one bounded writing call. Image and video ads use Brand DNA and visual evidence; quick mode uses a bounded storyboard, and explicitly requested deep mode adds frames and up to 30 seconds of transcription.

operations.title: Read Current Offer Registry
operations.description: Read the current store-scoped commercial offer record. Bily reconciles active and scheduled Shopify discounts and coupon codes with offer evidence from currently running ads, including freshness and Shopify-verification state.

operations.title: Generate Static Creative Draft
operations.description: Generate and save a workspace-scoped static image ad in Bily’s creative library. Bily plans a testable concept from Brand DNA, the current Offer Registry, the selected completed analysis and available performance evidence. Website workspaces use the selected brand reference without inventing merchandise; Shopify workspaces require a verified catalog product reference. Bily’s managed image generation retains progress and results. This creates an internal draft only, never a platform ad or delivery change. Poll the returned generation ID with getGenerated until ready or failed.

operations.title: List Bily Generated Ad Images
operations.description: List the existing generated-image library in this exact workspace, including processing, ready and failed generation receipts. Generation automatically saves a library record; this read does not generate or publish anything. Follow offset/limit pages as needed and reuse a ready image only after reviewing it.

operations.title: Read Generated Ad Image Status
operations.description: Read one store-owned generation receipt and media reference. Poll this exact ID after generateStatic returns processing; only ready with a saved image is successful generation. Report the retained failure rather than claiming an image was created.

operations.title: Read Generated Creative Placements
operations.description: Read the retained placement-family images for one generated creative, without rendering additional images. Check each generation status before using its media.

operations.title: List Uploaded Creative References
operations.description: Read one bounded page of retained ready images and videos uploaded to this workspace. Includes existing analysis status; does not transfer media, analyze, generate or publish an ad.

operations.title: Read Uploaded Creative Status
operations.description: Read one exact retained workspace upload and its analysis status. Pending or failed reservations are visible only to their original creator. Ready media can be reused only after verification; this read never generates or publishes anything.

operations.title: Reserve a Creative Reference Upload
operations.description: Reserve one workspace image or video upload with a stable caller idempotency key. MCP returns a relative first-party PUT path for the declared file; resolve it against the MCP endpoint origin and transfer bytes outside MCP with the same creator’s separately authenticated browser session or Customer API write key and exact content length. An MCP OAuth grant alone cannot authenticate that transfer. The PUT verifies storage and schedules internal paid analysis; finalizeUpload is an idempotent verification/recovery step. MCP does not fetch caller URLs, read local files, return signed storage credentials, or create an ad.

operations.title: Verify a Transferred Creative Reference
operations.description: Finalize the exact original creator’s upload after transferring its bytes to the returned PUT transport. Bily verifies the reserved storage object, MIME, size, signature and image metadata before marking it ready, then schedules existing paid creative analysis. A ready upload with analysisScheduled:false is a partial scheduling outcome; retain the receipt and retry only analysis. Repeating finalize never overwrites media or creates a second upload.

operations.title: Schedule Uploaded Reference Analysis
operations.description: Explicitly request or recover the existing bounded paid analysis for one retained ready workspace upload. Reuses the atomic analysis schedule and completed evidence; it does not upload, create an organic post, generate a new image or publish an ad. Poll getUpload or the exact upload analysis until ready or failed.

operations.title: Prepare Creative Placements
operations.description: Prepare only the missing placement archetypes for an existing ready Bily creative. The 4:5 feed master remains the default; full-screen, square, or Pinterest compositions are rendered lazily only after explicit user demand or when a campaign declares those placements. Existing family members are reused, and this never publishes or changes campaign delivery.

operations.title: Read MCP Platform Support
operations.description: Return connected ad accounts, the website-or-store resource type, and the exact write support matrix available for the current workspace.

operations.title: List Platform Assets
operations.description: List normalized campaigns, ad sets, and ads for a website or store workspace with platform, status, and text filters.

operations.title: Sync Connected Ad Accounts
operations.description: Re-import connected ad accounts for the current workspace and refresh Bily-managed metadata like pixels and account details.

operations.title: Finish Google Setup
operations.description: Reconcile the connected Google Ads, Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console, and Data Manager products into Bily-managed first-party routing. This action runs as one durable Bily action job; reuse the same caller-supplied idempotency key when retrying an ambiguously acknowledged request.

operations.title: List Supported Durable Ad Actions
operations.description: Read the exact provider action IDs accepted by saved ad drafts. Check platform support and exact connected accounts before preparing an action; this list does not imply every campaign format is supported.

operations.title: List Saved Ad Drafts
operations.description: List the authenticated operator’s saved Ads Manager changes in this exact workspace, including unpublished, running and retained failed changes. Follow the returned cursor before claiming to have reviewed all drafts. Does not publish anything.

operations.title: Save Unpublished Ad Actions
operations.description: Save 1–100 supported platform actions as one immutable unpublished Ads Manager draft. Use this normal draft-first path for campaign, ad-set/group, ad and creative creation, copy, rename, status and budget changes. Reuse the caller’s idempotency key only for the identical save. This never publishes or contacts an ad platform; publication is a separate reviewed action.

operations.title: Read Exact Saved Ad Draft
operations.description: Read the immutable actions and review for one saved ad draft or batch in the authenticated workspace and operator scope. Inspect its status, warnings, sources and every action before publication.

operations.title: Prepare Selected Ad Draft Batch
operations.description: Prepare 2–100 exact, distinct unpublished draft IDs for one batch review, up to 100 total platform actions. The server retains immutable draft references and orders them chronologically. Select explicit IDs from the saved queue; never silently include unreviewed or deferred drafts. This does not publish.

operations.title: Publish Reviewed Ad Draft or Batch
operations.description: Explicitly start one exact saved draft or prepared batch after its full review and user approval. Budget and activation changes can affect spend; platform-native removal requires separate exact destructive approval. The durable job continues if the caller leaves; a queued response is not completion. Poll getAdActionJob for the same ID and inspect every failure and partial platform receipt. Never replay an ambiguous platform mutation.

operations.title: Read Ad Publishing Results
operations.description: Read the canonical durable ad job, including action outcomes, verification receipts, errors, partial accepted identities, cancellation and retry eligibility. Queued or running is not successful publication. Failed or uncertain writes must remain visible and must not be blindly replayed.

operations.title: Stop Remaining Ad Actions
operations.description: Request cancellation of the exact saved or running durable ad job. Completed provider changes remain in place; an in-flight write may still finish. Read the job afterward and preserve every accepted provider identity. This does not undo published changes.

operations.title: Prepare Safe Ad Retry Draft
operations.description: Prepare a separate unpublished retry draft only for actions the canonical job marks safe to retry. Unsupported or ambiguous writes fail closed; this neither publishes the retry nor changes the original job history. Review the returned draft before a separate approved publish.

operations.title: Discard or Dismiss Saved Ad Changes
operations.description: Discard one unpublished draft, or remove a terminal job from the saved-changes listing. Published provider changes and durable result evidence remain unchanged. Do not dismiss failed or deferred jobs merely to make a test look clean.

operations.title: Read Exact Native Budget for Review
operations.description: Read one exact Meta campaign or owned ad-set budget, or Google campaign budget, in native account currency and integer units. Version 1 returns a budgetGuard only for an eligible exact native owner. An inherited Meta ad-set budget requires selecting its campaign; Bily never retargets the selected row. Google supports STANDARD DAILY amount_micros and verifies the complete affected set of at most 100 campaigns, including explicitly shared budgets with one actual user. Missing/ambiguous owners, incomplete shared scope and Google CUSTOM_PERIOD/other budget types are ineligible. Classic VIDEO and any shared budget with a non-removed VIDEO member are read only; missing or unknown native family proof is ineligible. Use the unchanged absolute approved amount plus this guard in a reviewed update-asset draft; changed amount, owner, currency, cadence or source requires a fresh review. Bily publications serialize the exact native budget owner across jobs and authorized sources; external platform changes can still race after the final read. The fresh reader reports bounded global coordination guidance without releasing or replaying unknown outcomes.

operations.title: Update Platform Asset
operations.description: Advanced immediate provider operation to rename, pause, resume, archive, or rebudget supported campaigns and ad sets, plus supported ad-level actions. Normal Ads Manager requests should saveAdDraft first, read/review it, then explicitly publishAdDraft. Meta and Google budget writes require the version 1 budgetGuard from read-asset-budget, exact selected native owner/parent and a budget-only update with the unchanged cadence. Old unguarded absolute/relative budget bodies require a new review and submit no budget change. Bily never rebases the saved absolute amount or retargets an inherited Meta ad set. Google shared scope must be complete and at most 100; CUSTOM_PERIOD is unsupported. Generic Google status/name/removal is checked against the exact fresh native campaign and parent; classic VIDEO and budgets affecting VIDEO are read only. Dedicated Demand Gen video remains supported; the native v24+ responsive Video-ad-info and experiment exceptions are not generic update-asset operations. Native-owner arbitration covers separate jobs and authorized aliases. New unguarded budget drafts fail Save; overbound mixed financial jobs require a split review. Busy or unknown outcomes never replay automatically; unknown outcomes quarantine the exact owner with its original receipt beyond job retirement. ARCHIVED maps to native removal for Google, TikTok and Snapchat; require separate exact destructive approval rather than treating it as a reversible pause. Authorized Slack requests use this same workspace-scoped capability; pausing an ad requires its exact platform, asset type, and asset ID. This generic outer sourceAuthority remains GOOGLE_ADS only; Meta budget source is bound inside budgetGuard. Other providers and nonbudget fields keep their previous contracts.

sourceAuthority.description: GOOGLE_ADS only: use the exact enabled account and connector pair from the current workspace selection. Omit for other platforms.

operations.title: Read TikTok Traffic Asset, Locations and Existing Posts
operations.description: Read one exact connected campaign, ad group or ad and its source fingerprint. Campaign reads can list up to 250 eligible country locations and currency-specific budget rules. Ad-group reads can list up to 50 linked TT_USER identities and up to 20 existing public video posts for one explicitly selected identity, with post fingerprints and pagination flags. No media upload or organic post is created.

operations.title: Create TikTok Website Traffic Groups and Spark Ads (Paused First)
operations.description: Create a paused manual website Traffic ad group, create a paused Spark Pull ad from an existing eligible public video post under a linked TT_USER identity, or duplicate an eligible ad. Requires exact source and current parent/source fingerprints; a new ad also requires the reviewed post fingerprint and HTTPS destination. Save through saveAdDraft and publish the exact reviewed draft. Requires currency-specific budget minimum/precision and a valid UTC schedule. CBO, Smart+, Search, catalog, app campaigns, uploads, new organic posts, other identity types and other formats are unsupported. Completion requires native readback; never replay uncertain writes.

name.description: No emojis. Han, Hiragana and Katakana characters count twice toward the 512-character native limit.

budget.description: Account currency. Require the current supported minimum and currency precision; lifetime minimum depends on scheduled days.

name.description: No emojis. Han, Hiragana and Katakana characters count twice toward the 512-character native limit.
No emojis. Han, Hiragana and Katakana characters count twice toward the 512-character native limit.

operations.title: Read Snapchat Asset, Budget Owner and Eligible Creatives
operations.description: Read the exact connected Snapchat campaign, ad squad or ad, including verified parent linkage, current source fingerprint and eligibility. Request forManagement on an ad squad or ad for supported name/status fields and existing budget ownership, independently of Traffic creation eligibility. Ad-squad reads may include at most 50 existing same-advertiser Web View creatives with fingerprints.

operations.title: Manage Snapchat Ad Squads and Ads with Verified Readback
operations.description: Update an existing ad squad or ad name/status, or change an existing squad-owned auction budget without changing cadence, schedule, pacing, targeting or creative. Also create paused Traffic ad squads/ads from existing same-advertiser Web View creatives, or duplicate an eligible Web View ad. Requires the exact source, current parent/source fingerprint and reviewed creative fingerprint for a new ad. Save through saveAdDraft and publish the reviewed draft; completion requires native readback. New media, other creation formats and campaign-paced/Smart Budget/reserved child budgets are unsupported. Uncertain writes must not be replayed.

operations.title: Read Pinterest Asset for Row Editing
operations.description: Read the exact connected Pinterest campaign, ad group or ad, including parent linkage, budget ownership and a stale-draft fingerprint.

operations.title: Create Pinterest Ad Groups and Image Ads (Paused First)
operations.description: Create a paused standard Awareness or Consideration ad group under the selected campaign, respecting campaign budget ownership; create a paused image ad from a new ad-only Pin; create a new image variation without editing the source ad; or duplicate a standard ad-only image ad. Requires the current source fingerprint. Completion requires provider readback. Partial Pin and ad IDs remain recovery references and uncertain writes must not be replayed.

operations.title: Read Saved Bily Images for Meta Upload
operations.description: Read 1–10 ready retained image generations in the exact Bily workspace before uploading them to the selected Meta advertiser. Returns current media fingerprints, dimensions, type and byte size. No storage keys, signed URLs or arbitrary image bytes are accepted or returned.

operations.title: Upload Saved Bily Images to Meta
operations.description: Upload 1–10 reviewed ready Bily image generations to the selected Meta advertiser’s retained image library using the existing image upload owner. Requires per-image media fingerprints; maximum 8 MiB and 4096×4096 per image, 40 MiB total. Creates no campaign, ad or creative. Returns exact account-owned native image hashes and image fingerprints for a later carousel draft. Accepted partial hashes must be reconciled; uploads are never automatically replayed or deleted.

operations.title: Read Meta Asset for Row Editing
operations.description: Read the exact connected Meta campaign, ad set, website image or static carousel creative, including budget ownership and a stale-draft fingerprint. For a carousel use forCarousel:true; ad-set reads can includeCarouselAssets:true to list bounded retained images, promotable Pages and Instagram identities. For a complete Awareness Reach image package use assetType:account, the numeric advertiser assetId and forAwareness:true. For the dedicated website Leads image family use forWebsiteLeads:true to review current account, Page, retained-image and workspace-pixel fingerprints; pixels are intersected with the selected advertiser native edge. Its attributionWindow is the supported fixed ONE_DAY_CLICK profile. Image fingerprints exclude signed media URLs.

operations.title: Manage Meta Ad Set, Image or Carousel Creative (Paused First)
operations.description: Create a complete paused Awareness website-image package with operation:create-awareness-website-image: one daily-budget OUTCOME_AWARENESS campaign, one REACH/IMPRESSIONS ad set bound to the selected Page, and one static Facebook Feed image ad with its reviewed website link; no Awareness WEBSITE destination override. The separate operation:create-leads-website-image creates one paused OUTCOME_LEADS campaign, WEBSITE/OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS/IMPRESSIONS ad set with an explicit current workspace/advertiser pixel and LEAD event, and linked Facebook Feed image ad. It requires expectedPixelFingerprint and attributionWindow:ONE_DAY_CLICK as its supported fixed profile. Both require exact account, Page, retained-image fingerprints, daily budget, reviewed copy/link/tracking and complete native readback; no instant form, messaging, app, video, Lead carousel or other attribution profile. Existing Traffic/Sales ad-set, image and static carousel operations retain their own eligibility. Receipts retain exact accepted IDs; uncertain writes must not be replayed.

operations.title: Read Google Search Ad Creative
operations.description: Read the exact workspace-linked advertiser, ad group and responsive Search ad, including text, pinning, destination/tracking URLs and a fingerprint for stale-draft protection.

operations.title: Preview Google Search Campaign or Ad Group Copy
operations.description: Read the exact workspace-linked Search source, budget, targeting, bids, asset associations and responsive ads. Returns bounded counts and a fingerprint for reviewing a durable copy draft.

operations.title: Duplicate Google Search Campaign or Ad Group
operations.description: Duplicate a reviewed standard Search campaign or ad group in the same advertiser. Preserves supported targeting, bid settings, URLs, pinning and asset associations; includes children when requested. Campaigns receive an independent matching daily budget. All new delivery objects are paused. Source changes and unsupported settings fail before the single atomic provider write; accepted identities survive verification failure.

operations.title: Preview Performance Max Asset Group Copy
operations.description: Read the exact native asset group, advertiser creative links, complete audience signals, URL settings and product-filter tree. Returns bounded graph counts and a current fingerprint for a copy draft. Automatic assets and incomplete graphs fail closed.

operations.title: Duplicate Performance Max Asset Group
operations.description: Copy the complete reviewed advertiser-owned asset-group graph in the same campaign. Preserves media, text, URLs, audiences, signals and product filters. The new group stays paused; Off creative links are restored in a separate validated and fenced phase. Never replay an ambiguous write; retain created native identities when verification is incomplete.

operations.title: Create or Edit Google Search Assets
operations.description: Create an additional Search ad group with keywords and a responsive Search ad atomically, add or duplicate a paused ad under an existing group, or edit reviewed ad copy. All new assets are paused. Existing-ad edits require a current creative fingerprint and preserve delivery status. Writes are durable draft actions; never replay an ambiguous platform mutation.

operations.title: Read Performance Max Asset Group
operations.description: Read one exact workspace-linked Performance Max asset group, its campaign, delivery state and destination URLs. Set payload.includeTextAssets=true to include advertiser, paused and automatic headline/long-headline/description links in the review fingerprint.

includeTextAssets.description: Read and fingerprint all current text links before a text edit. Return this flag with the reviewed update.

operations.title: Edit Performance Max Asset Group
operations.description: Rename, pause, enable, remove, update destination URLs or replace reviewed advertiser text for a Performance Max asset group. Text edits require includeTextAssets=true and its current fingerprint. New paused text and removals requiring temporary link activation need the group to start and finish paused. Respect committed placement minimums and capacities; verify separate create/remove phases before restoring reviewed link states. Preserve shared assets, automatic text, other creative links, signals and feed filters. Verify every phase without replay or hidden group activation. Group removal is irreversible; budget belongs to the parent campaign.

includeTextAssets.description: Read and fingerprint all current text links before a text edit. Return this flag with the reviewed update.

textAssets.description: Complete desired advertiser text links. Requires includeTextAssets and its current fingerprint. New PAUSED text and removals requiring temporary link activation need a currently PAUSED group that remains PAUSED. Preserve required placement minimums. Commit and verify replacement links before separate removals, then restore reviewed link states; publish group status changes separately. Automatic text and all other creative links stay untouched.

operations.title: Read Demand Gen Video Creative
operations.description: Read a bounded library of existing same-advertiser YouTube video and square logo assets, or fingerprint an exact standard non-product-feed Demand Gen ad group or video ad. Library results contain at most 50 videos and 50 eligible logos with has-more flags. No video upload or platform mutation is performed.

operations.title: Create or Edit a Paused Demand Gen Video Ad
operations.description: Add a video ad under an existing standard non-product-feed Demand Gen ad group or edit its reviewed video creative. Save through bily.actions.saveAdDraft, review, then publish the saved draft. Require the current parent/ad fingerprint and existing same-advertiser YouTube video plus square logo asset references. Edits atomically pause the ad and replace only reviewed creative fields; Google ad names are immutable. Validate before the write and independently read back the exact paused creative. No upload pipeline, product-feed variant, classic Video campaign mutation or automatic replay is supported.

operations.title: Create Google Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Create an exact-source paused Search, Display, Demand Gen, Performance Max, Shopping, App, Hotel or Travel campaign with its native hierarchy. Non-Search payloads require explicit campaignType, targeting and the required creative or linked product account. Demand Gen supports image creatives or format VIDEO with existing same-advertiser YouTube video and square logo asset references; video creation is verified by native hierarchy, creative, budget and targeting reads. Performance Max uses asset groups. Validate the complete payload before saving a launch draft. Classic Video, Smart and Local Services creation are unavailable through the API.

images.description: Include landscape marketing, square marketing and square logo images. Bily validates actual bytes, dimensions, placement ratios and the combined 8 MB limit.

operations.title: Resolve Google Campaign Targeting
operations.description: Resolve reviewed ISO country and Google language codes to current targetable references for one exact connected advertiser. No campaign or asset is changed.

operations.title: Validate Google Campaign Without Creating It
operations.description: Ask Google to validate the exact paused campaign payload and account eligibility before review. This fixed validation-only operation never creates campaign, budget or creative objects. Validation is not publication and does not guarantee later policy approval.

images.description: Include landscape marketing, square marketing and square logo images. Bily validates actual bytes, dimensions, placement ratios and the combined 8 MB limit.

operations.title: Create TikTok Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Create a new TikTok campaign with one exact objectiveType: REACH, TRAFFIC, VIDEO_VIEWS, ENGAGEMENT, LEAD_GENERATION, APP_PROMOTION, WEB_CONVERSIONS, or PRODUCT_SALES. Declare housing, employment, or credit with specialIndustries when applicable. Connected-channel creation requires explicit PAUSED status; standard campaign budgets must be at least 50 in account currency.

operations.title: Clone TikTok Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Clone an existing TikTok campaign into the same ad account. Connected-channel cloning requires explicit PAUSED status.

operations.title: Create Pinterest Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Create a new Pinterest campaign with one current objectiveType: AWARENESS, CONSIDERATION, VIDEO_COMPLETION, SALES, or LEADS. intendedPromotionType is STANDARD_AD or CATALOG; CATALOG is only valid with SALES or CONSIDERATION. Connected-channel creation requires explicit PAUSED status; lifetime budgets require an endTime.

intendedPromotionType.description: CATALOG is valid only with SALES or CONSIDERATION.

endTime.description: ISO date-time or Unix timestamp; required for lifetime budgets.

operations.title: Clone Pinterest Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Clone an existing Pinterest campaign into the same ad account. Connected-channel cloning requires explicit PAUSED status.

operations.title: Create Snapchat Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Create a new Snapchat campaign with explicit PAUSED status and objectiveV2Properties.objective_v2_type set to AWARENESS_AND_ENGAGEMENT, SALES, TRAFFIC, APP_PROMOTION, or LEADS. For credit, housing, or employment campaigns, set regulations.restrictedDeliverySignals to true. Campaign budgets must be at least 20 in account currency.

operations.title: Clone Snapchat Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Clone an existing Snapchat campaign into the same ad account. Connected-channel cloning requires explicit PAUSED status.

operations.title: Create Meta Campaign Shell (Advanced, Paused First)
operations.description: Advanced parent-only operation. It does not create the required ad set or ad and must not be used to fulfill a campaign launch request; use create-meta-campaign-package for a launchable Traffic or Sales draft, or manage-meta-asset operation:create-awareness-website-image for the bounded complete Awareness Reach Facebook Feed image family. The shell accepts one exact objective: OUTCOME_AWARENESS, OUTCOME_TRAFFIC, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT, OUTCOME_LEADS, OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION, or OUTCOME_SALES, plus an explicit specialAdCategories declaration. Creation requires explicit PAUSED status; lifetime budgets require endTime and may include startTime.

operations.title: Create Complete Meta Campaign Package (Paused First)
operations.description: Create one linked Meta Traffic or Sales campaign, ad set, creative, and image ad as a complete PAUSED package. Sales requires the exact dataset or pixel id. The result returns exact parent-linked ids and a cleanup receipt. Publishing is a separate explicit action and must update ad, then ad set, then campaign; never blindly retry an ambiguous platform mutation.

operations.title: List Live Meta Campaigns
operations.description: Read live Meta provider campaign metadata for a workspace-linked Facebook ad account by exact campaign IDs, names, or name prefix. Returns IDs, names, statuses, objective, budget, and timestamps without exposing tokens.

operations.title: Duplicate Meta Campaign (Paused First)
operations.description: Copy a Meta campaign with its ad sets and ads using native duplication. All copied objects remain paused.

operations.title: Clone Meta Ad Set (Paused First)
operations.description: Clone an existing Meta ad set into the same or another campaign. Connected-channel cloning requires explicit PAUSED status.

operations.title: Clone Meta Ad (Paused First)
operations.description: Clone an existing Meta ad (and its creative reference) into a target ad set. Connected-channel cloning requires explicit PAUSED status.

operations.title: Create Meta Image Ad (Paused First)
operations.description: Upload one image, create its Meta creative, and create a new ad inside an existing ad set. The ad is always created PAUSED and the response includes a receipt that records whether the image was new or reused.

operations.title: Delete Bily-Created Meta Image Ad
operations.description: Delete a Meta ad and creative only when the exact ids match a recent Bily creation receipt for the same workspace and ad account. Delete the image only when that receipt proves Bily created a new image instead of reusing one.
